title: 3 Meals From 1 Rotisserie Chicken
editorialNotes: Rotisserie price and stock-value figures ($6, $8-12) are body copy, not hero type.

thread.element: chicken progressing whole, carved, shredded, then stock

copy.headline: One $6 rotisserie chicken. Three meals. Zero waste.
Night 1: Eat it.
items: Serve with whatever you have — rice, salad, bread. This is the easy one. Save every bone and scrap.

copy.headline: Day 2: Shred the leftovers.
copy.body: Pull all remaining meat off the bones. Toss into a grain bowl with greens, pickled onion, and whatever sauce is in the fridge. Or make chicken salad. Or quesadillas.

copy.headline: Day 3: Bone broth.
items: Carcass + water + an onion + 2 celery stalks + salt.
Simmer 2–4 hours (or 45 min in a pressure cooker).
You now have 6–8 cups of stock worth $8–12 at the store.

copy.headline: $6 bird. 3 meals. Plus free stock for next week's soup.
